meta.list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned.
meta.namesSource: Exophase and PSNProfiles, agreeing on every name, description and grade.
meta.guidesNote: Every guide is our own words, written from the official description. Specific locations and steps are not yet verified in the game; each guide says so where it applies.

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the roadmap in order (story, strangers, activities, collectibles, money) and let the tracker show exactly what is left. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. This is the first story mission, so it unlocks early in Chapter 1 as you play through the story. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Play through the opening chapter's missions in order; the trophy unlocks when the chapter ends. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Keep playing the story missions in order; the trophy unlocks when Chapter 2 ends. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Play through the chapter's story missions in order; the trophy unlocks when the chapter ends. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Play through the chapter's story missions in order; the trophy unlocks when the chapter ends. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Finish the last story mission; the trophy unlocks at the end of the story. Before you start it, clear the missable trophies and stranger strands first — see the Missables page. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Play it when it appears in the story and finish it. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. This is a story heist mission; finish it when it appears. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. A story mission; finish it when it appears. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. A story mission; finish it when it appears. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission at the airport (VCIA); finish it when it appears. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission; finish it when it appears. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. This is the long one: finish the story, all stranger strands, activities, collectibles and challenges. Use this tracker to tick off each category and check the in-game 100% checklist as you go. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the game's jump and ramp challenges; look for stunt jumps around Leonida and land them. Track your count here (target 250). The exact stunt-jump locations are not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 types of activity once. Play one of every activity the game offers (races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling, meditation and the rest) — you only need to try each once. The full list of the 9 types is not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges (42 challenges, per PSN). Visit the shooting range and work through its challenges, aiming for gold on each. The range's location and the challenge list are not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location (14 locations, per the official list). Find the Top Fun drone-race spots around Leonida and win a race at each one. Where the 14 spots are is not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter races around Leonida and win 20 distinct ones. Track your wins here (target 20). Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and take him on in a fishing challenge, then out-fish him. Where Cal is and how the challenge works is not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade machine and play one game through to the end. The arcade locations are not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Work through Andy's mission strand and finish his last mission. Where Andy's strand starts is not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's mission strand and finish his last mission. Where Kenton's strand starts is not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Work through Billy's mission strand and finish his last mission. Where Billy's strand starts is not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Seek out stranger encounters (marked on the map when they appear) and finish 8 full strands. Do these before the final mission — stranger content can close off as the story advances, so do not leave them all to the end. The exact stranger locations are not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.missableNote: Stranger content can close off as the story advances. Do these before the final mission.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Work through Randy's mission strand and finish his last mission. Where Randy's strand starts is not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Work through Tyrone's mission strand and finish his last mission. Where Tyrone's strand starts is not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida (18 spots, per the official list). Find the meditation spots scattered around the map and meditate at each one. Where the 18 spots are is not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take on Bret's hunting request and track down the unique animal he wants. Which animal and where it roams is not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find collectible cards around Leonida and complete 3 full sets. The cards' locations are not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different spots around Leonida. Track your count here (target 100). The WAiNK spots' locations are not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Work through the game's challenge list (stunts, races, activities and more) and finish 50 of them. Track your count here (target 50). Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and escape until the stars clear. You can retry this any time. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row and keep the wanted level alive between them. You can retry this any time. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Find and get into 100 different vehicles around Leonida — each new one you discover counts. Track your count here (target 100). Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus during a fight and defeat 5 enemies before it ends. Pick a busy firefight so you have enough targets. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get to the airport (VCIA) and leave by an unscheduled route — the description implies taking a plane or a runway exit without a scheduled flight. You can retry this any time. The exact method is not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Get into a Rhino tank and use it — the description hints at driving or fighting in one. Where to find a Rhino is not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Pick a jewelry store, get in and out with the loot without tripping the alarm or being spotted. You can retry this any time. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get away clean each time. Track your count here (target 5). You can retry this any time. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and get away. You can retry this any time. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida (52 areas, per the official list). Travel the whole map — every region of Leonida — until the map is fully revealed. Track your progress here. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang (9 gangs, per the official list). Find and rob an illegal operation run by each of Leonida's gangs. Which gangs and where their operations are is not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view, and order a cocktail. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. During the story's vehicle-showroom sequence, break out of the showroom by driving through it. This is a one-time story beat — do it when the sequence plays, and if you miss it, mission replay may be your only way back. The exact mission is not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.missableNote: A one-time story showroom sequence. Do it when the sequence plays; mission replay may be the only way back if missed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a game (follow through on your throw). Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Do a partner activity that builds your partnership's appeal — the description suggests a co-op activity with your partner that draws a crowd. The exact activity is not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count toward 500 for this trophy, so the choices you make across the game add up — keep making story choices and the count climbs. Which choices count is not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description suggests a retry or a second attempt pays off — try again after a first failure at the relevant moment. The exact moment is not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden or strange moment in the game — an easter egg or an odd event. Keep an eye out for unusual encounters as you explore. The exact trigger is not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving by the bowling alley (or in a vehicle), hit the pins with a melee attack from the vehicle. The exact setup is not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Collect Marked Bills (from heists and robberies) and launder them through your contacts until you have cleaned $250,000. Track your total here (target $250,000). Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, vehicles and more across Leonida's shops until you have spent $100,000 in total. Track your total here (target $100,000). Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties (8 garages, per the official list). Buy every garage property available around Leonida. Where the 8 garages are and their prices are not yet verified in the game. Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, then register them through the Scooter Bros app until you have 10 registered. Track your count here (target 10). Our own advice from the official description; not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: On the Spot
